title: SeatWiFi
description: In-flight WiFi: provider by flight, airline or tail, measured speeds, Starlink rollout.
summary: In-flight WiFi: provider by flight, airline or tail, measured speeds, Starlink rollout.
offersHint: In-flight WiFi: provider by flight, airline or tail, measured speeds, Starlink rollout. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.seatwifi.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_wifi_facts
toolsPreview.description: Best answer for "will this flight have WiFi". Predicts the WiFi provider for a flight number on a given date, with probability, the tail number expected to operate it, aircraft type, and the airline fleet fallback. Prefer this over get_flight_wifi.

toolsPreview.name: get_flight_wifi
toolsPreview.description: Shorter WiFi lookup for a flight number: provider, confidence, airline, aircraft, and Starlink status. Use get_wifi_facts instead when you need the date, tail number, or reasoning.

toolsPreview.name: get_airline_wifi
toolsPreview.description: WiFi providers an airline uses fleet-wide, plus a fleet summary and whether WiFi is free. Use when the question is about the airline rather than one flight.

toolsPreview.name: get_rollouts
toolsPreview.description: Starlink and satellite WiFi rollout progress per aircraft type: status (complete, in_progress, planned, announced), fleet percentage, and expected completion. Omit airline_code for every tracked airline.

toolsPreview.name: get_speed_stats
toolsPreview.description: Crowd-sourced in-flight WiFi speed reports: average download/upload Mbps, latency, and a per-provider breakdown. Use for "is the WiFi fast enough" questions. Pass a flight_number or an airline_code, not both.

toolsPreview.name: get_tail_info
toolsPreview.description: WiFi provider history for one aircraft by tail number, including crowd-sourced reports and fleet assignment. Use when the exact airframe is known.

toolsPreview.name: search_wifi
toolsPreview.description: Free-text search across airlines and flights when you only have a name or partial term. Use a specific tool instead when you already have a flight number, airline code, or tail number.

toolsPreview.name: list_airlines
toolsPreview.description: Every airline SeatWiFi tracks, with its WiFi providers. Large response — use search_wifi or get_airline_wifi when you know which airline you want.
